description: This file contains unit tests for the SkillAPI class, part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It tests CRUD operations via API endpoints using PHPUnit in a test suite with mock services and fixture data.

classes.name: SkillAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the SkillAPI REST endpoints, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting skills.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment by truncating Skill table and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all skills via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll API tests.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single skill via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getOne API tests.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new skill via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create API tests.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing skill via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update API tests.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a skill via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for the delete API tests.
